writing.overall_comment: A strong, well-scoped and actionable advanced Git skill whose main weakness is a factually reversed git bisect exit-code comment in the automated script example.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and rich description accurately frame the skill as advanced Git mastery, and the body's coverage of rebase, worktree, reflog, bisect, commits, and history cleanup matches the stated scope.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: Examples are plentiful and mostly correct, but the automated bisect script's comment ('Return 0 if bug is present (bad), 1 if fixed (good)') inverts git bisect run's actual exit-code convention (0=good, 1-127=bad), which would mislead users, and section numbering skips 7-8.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: Commands are concrete, sequential, and executable, with explicit response patterns and a safety-first workflow that make the guidance easy to follow.
